verdict.rationale: First-party pages advertise a free developer tier ('Spin up a dev instance to kick the tires', up to 4 vCPU / 8 GB RAM, 'No credit card required'). The docs describe a self-serve path from signup to first query in about five minutes (create a cluster, connect any ClickHouse client, load data, query), which covers real queries on real data without a sales call. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the signup flow, and documented limits of the free tier such as storage caps, duration, or data-volume restrictions.
